residual: Exact target structure, including the complete target RHS as a generated equality endpoint, is reachable but does not attach to the target-LHS component.

rivals.R1_REENTRY_FAILURE: Useful generated endpoints are not re-used as source-instantiation terms; one bounded lawful re-entry generation should add cross-component edges or close the target.
rivals.R2_CHAIN_ASSEMBLY_FAILURE: Useful endpoints are already reusable, but existing equalities are not composed into a path; re-entry should add no decision-changing connectivity.
rivals.R3_DEEPER_SEARCH_REQUIRED: The current endpoint is useful but one re-entry generation is insufficient; it may create novel components/coverage without closure.
rivals.R4_MEASUREMENT_ARTIFACT: The apparent exact target endpoint is only alpha-shape coverage rather than a literal target endpoint; exact endpoint audit should falsify the premise.

decision_rule: First audit literal equality of generated endpoints against the parsed target sides.
If no literal target RHS endpoint exists, decide R4_MEASUREMENT_ARTIFACT.
Otherwise seed exactly one bounded source-reentry generation using only novel target-narrowing endpoints already generated by the frozen parent search.
If this closes a replayable target proof or joins the target-side components, decide R1_REENTRY_FAILURE.
If it adds graph edges but no target-component progress, decide R3_DEEPER_SEARCH_REQUIRED.
If it adds no lawful new edges, decide R2_CHAIN_ASSEMBLY_FAILURE.
